history_summary: Record eleven native species-reference GTDB correspondences for the LDSynCom stock descriptors.
history_details: The exact NCBI-ID routes supply eleven reference-taxon mappings while preserving all eleven distinct study stocks, assembly and BioSample strings, duplicate species entries and STRMAP identities. Reference genome counts and rounded majority fractions do not reassign the study-stock assemblies, establish exact numerators or measure abundance. Preserve the 121-library to 15-candidate to 11-member selection boundaries, excluded strains, every source quotation and all biological fields. Native GTDB label differences are database correspondences rather than formal stock renaming. Only eleven GTDB blocks/statuses and two native inline events changed. Existing issues 2314, 2315 and 2316 retain source-completeness, growth/phenolic-proxy and quotation limitations; this technical correction does not approve structural lignin mineralization, biofilm mechanism or full-record science. The pinned crosswalk's upstream release is unestablished.
